headline: Visual Designer
tagline: Junior designer delivering brand identity systems, marketing collateral, and print-ready assets.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and Visual Identity, Typography, Layout, Print Production, Social/Marketing Creative, Wireframing

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Developed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.
Produced wireframes and prototypes using Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Designed logo, typography, and color palette for early-stage business branding.
Established visual consistency across initial brand assets.

projects.name: Social Campaign for Fashion Brand
bullets: Created Instagram and Facebook series that generated a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)
